snapshot.what_it_does: HDFC Bank Limited is a bank delivering financial solutions to large corporates, mid-market companies, MSMEs and retail customers, combining a strong portfolio with customer insights. Its offerings span loans and deposits, investment banking, and other banking products and services such as cash management, trade finance, treasury, forex and derivatives.

segments.name: Wholesale Banking
segments.note: Services large corporates, multinationals, government entities, public sector enterprises, emerging corporates and business banking/SME customers; products include working capital facilities, term lending, project and infrastructure finance, supply chain and export finance, debt/equity capital markets, M&A, loan syndication, forex & derivatives, custodial services, letters of credit and guarantees (p71).

segments.name: Retail / MSME
segments.note: The report states the Bank serves mid-market companies, MSMEs and retail customers; a dedicated retail segment description is not provided in the material (p71).

snapshot.geographies: Primarily India (report is an Indian bank's Integrated Annual Report; per-share data sourced from NSE). Overseas operations exist: overseas total assets of ₹86,595.81 crore, NPAs of ₹90.48 crore and revenue of ₹4,755.94 crore as at/for the year ended March 31, 2026 (p426).
key_facts: Net revenues of ₹1,91,218.60 crore and profit after tax of ₹74,671.30 crore in FY 2025-26 (p259)
Deposits of ₹31,05,250.47 crore and loans of ₹29,37,166.27 crore as at March 31, 2026 (p259)
Total capital ratio 19.71% and Tier 1 capital ratio 17.73% as at March 31, 2026 (p259)
Gross NPAs of ₹34,061.19 crore, 1.15% of gross advances of ₹29,60,018.17 crore as at March 31, 2026 (p426)
98% of all financial transactions are digital and 99% of personal loans originated digitally; 2,11,178 total employees (p33)

items.statement: RBI has approved Keki Mistry as Interim Part-Time Chairman for a fixed period
items.speaker: Keki Mistry
items.quote: The Reserve Bank of India has approved my appointment as the Interim Part-Time Chairman for a period of 3 months.

items.statement: Nomination and remuneration committee will consider MD & CEO reappointment in due course; process unchanged
items.horizon: next few months (term due in ~7 months)
items.speaker: Keki Mistry
items.quote: It is something that will be considered by the nomination and remuneration committee. There is still time to do that.

items.statement: Board will meet soon and decide on seeking explanation from the outgoing chairman and on next steps
items.speaker: Keki Mistry
items.quote: Obviously, the board will meet soon, and we will take a call on what to do.

items.statement: New chairman and replacement independent director will be decided within the interim period, in consultation with RBI and SEBI
items.speaker: Keki Mistry
items.quote: There is a full 3-month period during which the Board will meet, take a call on who should be the Chairman.

items.statement: Deputy Managing Director will get more responsibilities going forward
items.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan
items.quote: In fact, he will only get more responsibilities as we move forward.

items.statement: Growth plans and operational commitments remain unchanged despite the chairman's resignation
items.speaker: Keki Mistry
items.quote: What happened yesterday has nothing whatsoever to do with operational profitability of the bank... the bank will commit to do whatever it has said in its calls that it would do.

items.statement: Fruits of the merger will start to play out and bank is positioned to deliver as committed; technology expected to surprise over next couple of years
items.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan
items.quote: The fruits of the merger will start to play out... We have technology which is going to surprise us over the next couple of years.

items.statement: Organization structure will be re-examined and new responsibilities for Kaizad announced after board approval, post financial year closure (not before March end)
items.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan
items.quote: we will sort of re-examine our organization structure and with the consent and the advice of the board, we will announce it at the appropriate time

items.statement: Bank expects return to pre-merger growth trajectory
items.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan
items.quote: I think you will see the kind of growth that we have used to pre-merger coming back

items.statement: Technology to be a differentiator and a surprise over the next year or two
items.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan
items.quote: Technology is going to be differentiator, and you will see it more happening over the year and two. And that is going to be kind of a surprise

items.statement: Bank's performance in coming months and years will reflect strong governance
items.speaker: Keki Mistry
items.quote: we will in the coming years and coming months, the performance of the bank will also reflect that

items.statement: Growth to be picked up in mid-market segment via ECLGS scheme 5.0
items.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan
items.quote: The ECLGS scheme 5.0 is also a very good opportunity and you will see a fair amount of growth that we will pick up in the mid-market segment.

items.statement: GenAI lighthouse programs to go into production during the year
items.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan
items.quote: we do have a fair amount of lighthouse programs that will go into production during the course of the year.

items.statement: Margins may not have bottomed out quarter-to-quarter, but on a full-year basis the bank is well positioned to be better
items.speaker: Srinivasan Vaidyanathan
items.quote: we have to wait for the year to see, but we do think that on a full-year basis, we are well positioned... to be better.

items.statement: Cost of funds could improve by 40-50 basis points but not quickly
items.speaker: Srinivasan Vaidyanathan
items.quote: there can be 40, 50 basis points change, but it is not going to change in a hurry.

items.statement: Borrowing mix at 11% expected to come down via maturities and growth, not to 8-9% immediately
items.speaker: Srinivasan Vaidyanathan
items.quote: the borrowing mix which is at 11%, we don't expect that it will just settle at 8% or 9%... the maturity should take care of that to some extent.

items.statement: Retail mix to move from 52% toward ~60% over time
items.speaker: Srinivasan Vaidyanathan
items.quote: Today we are at a 52% retail mix... we were at about 60% or so... that's where we want to be as far as the retail mix is concerned.

items.statement: Significant FCNR(B) market share targeted; milestones in July-September, no number disclosed
items.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan
items.quote: you will see in the month of July, August, September, we have certain milestones... endeavor to ensure that we are reasonably strong and significant market share.

items.statement: Step-up in customer acquisition numbers and value expected over next nine months
items.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan
items.quote: maybe over the next nine months we hope to see a fair amount of change in the acquisition numbers and hence value.

items.statement: CASA ratio vision to reach near pre-merger levels of ~38%
items.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan
items.quote: the endeavor and our vision is to reach to somewhere near the pre-merger levels or just around the time of the merger, which was around 38.

items.statement: Healthy savings account growth expected over one to three years; efficiencies and better cost-to-income over next two-three years
items.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan
items.quote: you should see reasonably healthy growth over a one, two, three-year period in the savings account as well.

items.statement: Gain market share within existing customer base and from new-to-bank acquisitions
items.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan
items.quote: Gain market share within our existing base itself or even from a new-to-bank acquisitions as well. So that's going to be our next two, three-year journey

items.statement: Wallet share increase expected in wholesale corporate and capital markets segment as new technologies are implemented
items.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan
items.quote: even on that with the implementation of new technologies over a period of time... that will also sort of see a kind of a change in terms of the wallet share increase

reported.statement: Deposit growth better than historical Q1 trends; market share gains on incremental and stock basis
reported.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan
reported.quote: the deposit growth continues to be relatively better than the historical Q1 trends. We continue to gain market share both on an incremental basis and on a stock basis

reported.statement: Advances have done very well over the last three-four quarters
reported.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan
reported.quote: the advances have done very well over the last three, four quarters and that trajectory continues.

reported.statement: Per-branch productivity at INR 330 crores vs INR 266 crores in FY23; ~40% of branches less than 5 years old
reported.speaker: Srinivasan Vaidyanathan
reported.quote: we are about INR 330 crores per branch currently. And if you go back to the FY'23 time period, we were INR 266 crores per branch.

reported.statement: CASA grew 9.5-10% in year to March 2026, gaining market share
reported.speaker: Srinivasan Vaidyanathan
reported.quote: for the year that went by, for example, March 26... while we grew between 9.5% - 10% or so, we still gained market share on that

reported.statement: Borrowing mix currently about 11% of funding
reported.speaker: Srinivasan Vaidyanathan
reported.quote: the borrowing mix has not come off yet. We still remain at about 11%.

reported.statement: Retail mix of assets currently 52%
reported.speaker: Srinivasan Vaidyanathan
reported.quote: Today we are at a 52% retail mix.

reported.statement: Wholesale/non-retail deposits share risen from 17% to 20%
reported.speaker: Seshadri Sen (analyst, acknowledged by management)
reported.quote: the share of wholesale deposits rise albeit not by a large amount, but it's gone up from 17% to 20%.

reported.statement: Customer base a little more than 100 million
reported.speaker: Srinivasan Vaidyanathan
reported.quote: we are today little more than 100 million customers

reported.statement: Branch network at about 9,700 branches
reported.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan
reported.quote: depending on the capacity of the overall 9,700 branches

reported.statement: Reported profit growth of 5%; adjusted for one-timers (HDB gains, floating provision, contingent provisions) profit growth was 9.8%
reported.quote: adjusted for that, I think in one of our reports that we filed, it shows 9.8% profit growth

reported.statement: Balance sheet growth was well upwards of 13-14%
reported.quote: Balance sheet growth is well upwards of 13%, 14%

reported.statement: CASA ratio at 34%
reported.quote: sharp decline in CASA down to 34%

items.statement: Building new and deepening existing relationships will enable the liabilities engine to step up further in coming days
items.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan
items.quote: Building on these new acquired relationships and deepening our existing relationships will enable the liabilities engine to step up further in the coming days

items.statement: Proportion of retail deposits will become larger as balance sheet is restructured with non-deposit strategies
items.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan
items.quote: we probably will have the proportion of retail becoming larger and larger, and it will have a kind of a downstream impact on multiple metrics

items.statement: New CEO will unveil his strategy in about a month's time
items.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan
items.quote: Anup, in his next weeks or a couple of months' time will unveil his strategy... in probably a month's time or so

items.statement: New CEO will soon present a perspective on growth, margins, quality and productivity
items.speaker: Anup Bagchi
items.quote: I will soon present a perspective on growth, margins, quality and productivity built on disciplined capital deployment and a strong execution culture

items.statement: Margin trajectory is at the bottom; net of FCNR headwind and rate tailwind, margins can be neutral to positive going forward
items.speaker: Srinivasan Vaidyanathan
items.quote: net of that, we still think that there can be neutral to positive on the margin as we go forward... from a trajectory point of view, it is at the bottom

items.statement: Margin trajectory will be upward from the next quarter onwards
items.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan
items.quote: The trajectory will be upward from the next quarter onwards.

items.statement: Across the next 2 quarters, back book effect will change and margins will improve as retail and MSME volumes grow
items.speaker: Kaizad Bharucha
items.quote: going forward, across the next 2 quarters, you will see that change coming through as we also grow the volumes in retail and MSME

items.statement: NIMs, which bore the brunt of faster asset repricing, are positioned for reversal as the bank enters an upward rate cycle
items.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan
items.quote: net interest margins... in a down rate cycle is also positioned for a reversal as we enter the upward rate cycle

items.statement: Proportion of retail and MSME assets will outweigh corporate and home loans over a period of time
items.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan
items.quote: This will get further enhanced as the proportion of retail and MSME assets outweigh the proportion of corporate and home loans over a period of time

items.statement: From Q3 onwards there will be an uptick versus Q2, with full-quarter headwinds from Q2 items
items.speaker: Srinivasan Vaidyanathan
items.quote: These are the items that are in play, positives, and the headwinds will be some full-quarter impact of whatever has come through in Q2.

items.statement: Bank will come back with more vigor in retail assets and MSME, gaining calibrated market share in higher-yield products
items.speaker: Kaizad Bharucha
items.quote: You will see us having certainly come back with more vigor on our retail assets and MSME space.

items.statement: Opportunity to raise deposit market share in over 54% of 765 districts where share is 2-3 points below average
items.speaker: Srinivasan Vaidyanathan
items.quote: More than 54% of the districts, significant opportunity exists because we are 2 to 3 percentage points lower than our average market share.

reported.statement: Deposits grew 18.8% YoY reported, including ~4pp lift from special FCNR(B) window
reported.quote: Deposits increased 18.8% year-on-year on a reported basis, including a 4 percentage point lift from special FCNR (B) window

reported.quote: Total AUM grew 15.3% year-on-year, including a 1.9% impact of FCNR (B) leverage, with SME and retail assets leading the charge

reported.quote: The pace of retail disbursements is accelerating and has crossed Rs 90,000 crores during Q2 FY27 as against Rs 76,000 crores in Q1

reported.quote: our cost of funds is flat quarter-to-quarter, at about 4.4% last quarter to this quarter

reported.quote: September'26 EOP loan growth has grown 23.5% year-on-year compared to 17% to 18% year-on-year growth levels seen in the last few quarters
Our cost to assets is at about 1.74, 1.73 thereabouts, which again is low.

reported.value: single-digit % of book priced to MCLR

promised_vs_delivered.verdict: Management delivered on its checkable near-term promises — customer acquisition, MSME/mid-market growth, deposit momentum — with strong Q2 FY27 numbers, and operations held steady through the chairman's exit. However, most strategic pledges (margins, CASA, pre-merger growth) are long-dated and untested, and the material does not confirm chairman succession or the CEO strategy unveil.

rows.promise: Growth plans and operational commitments unchanged despite chairman's resignation
rows.delivered: PAT +10.7% Q4FY26, +18.4% Q1FY27, +5.6% Q2FY27; revenue YoY rose 5.5%→10.5%; Q2 deposits +18.8%

rows.promise: Return to pre-merger growth trajectory (medium term)
rows.delivered: Pre-merger growth rate not stated; early signs positive: Q2 AUM +15.3% YoY, deposits +18.8% YoY

rows.promise: New chairman and replacement independent director decided within 3-month interim period
rows.delivered: Material does not state whether a permanent chairman was appointed within the window

rows.promise: Step-up in customer acquisition numbers and value over next nine months
rows.delivered: Q2: 1.7M liability relationships (+25% vs Q1, +33% vs Q4); new credit cards 1.4M, +19% QoQ

rows.promise: Growth pickup in mid-market segment via ECLGS scheme 5.0
rows.delivered: Q2 MSME EOP loans +23.5% YoY vs 17-18% in prior quarters; business banking +28% YoY

rows.promise: Significant FCNR(B) market share; milestones in July-September
rows.delivered: Q2 deposits +18.8% incl ~4pp FCNR(B) lift; AUM +15.3% incl 1.9% FCNR impact; market share not quantified

rows.promise: FY27 full-year margins positioned to be better
rows.delivered: FY27 incomplete; Q2 NIM 3.32%, cost of funds flat QoQ at ~4.4%

rows.promise: CASA ratio vision toward pre-merger ~38% (long term)
rows.delivered: CASA ratio 34% in Q1; Q2 CASA grew 10.8%, retail CASA +11.2%; ratio not restated
rows.cite: Q1 FY27 reported p.11; Q2 FY27 reported p.3

rows.promise: Margin trajectory upward from Q3 FY27 onwards
rows.delivered: Q3 FY27 not yet reported; latest actuals end Sep-2026

rows.promise: New CEO to unveil his strategy in about a month
rows.delivered: Material does not state whether the strategy was unveiled

bull.point: Profit engine is large and accelerating: FY26 PAT ₹74,671 crore; Q2FY27 revenue +10.5% YoY, deposits +18.8%, AUM +15.3%.
bull.cite: annual-reports/annual-report-2026.md p259; promised_vs_delivered Q2 FY27 reported p.3

bull.point: Near-term promises landed: 1.7M new liability relationships (+25% vs Q1), MSME loans +23.5% YoY, business banking +28%.
Resilient balance sheet: GNPA 1.15%, total capital 19.71%, Tier 1 17.73%; 98% digital transactions aid efficiency.

bear.point: Earnings quality is uneven: Q1FY27 PAT fell 1.3% YoY; Q2FY27 PAT growth slowed to 5.6% despite revenue +10.5%.
Core strategic pledges remain untested: pre-merger growth, FY27 margin improvement, CASA toward 38%, and Q3FY27 margin upturn are all 'too early'.
bear.cite: promised_vs_delivered; Q1 FY27 reported p.11; Q2 FY27 reported p.7

bear.point: Governance visibility is incomplete: material does not confirm permanent chairman succession within three months or the new CEO's strategy unveil.

watch: Q3FY27 NIM and cost-of-funds trend versus promised margin upturn from Q3 FY27.
Whether CASA ratio is restated and moves from 34% toward the ~38% pre-merger vision.
Confirmation of permanent chairman, CEO strategy unveil, and measurable pre-merger growth trajectory.
